editorial.blurb: Pei Wei serves up vibrant Asian-inspired classics with consistently fresh ingredients and genuine hospitality that keeps guests coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the orange chicken for its perfectly crispy exterior and balanced sauce, and don't skip the lettuce wraps—reviewers praise the generous meat portions.
